search.note: bandNear = hitPos within radius+0.08 of corner triggers check. bandFar = perpDist+radius*2+0.15 search range. sectorThreshold = offP*dirSign > threshold rejects wrong quadrant

shading.note: When corner hit, Nw = mix(Nw, cornerNormal, normalMix). Slight albedo boost and roughness reduction makes corner catch light
